response.sql: WITH line AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget b LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS avg_total_of_above_avg_lines, SUM(l.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - o.avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM line l CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE l.total_cost > o.avg_total;

assumptions.assumption: Expenses whose link_to_budget is NULL or does not match a budget row are ignored, since the average is taken over lines in the budget table. Expenses are counted per matching budget line using expense_id.
Budget lines with no expenses have total 0 and are included in the overall average. Lines strictly above the average are kept; those equal to it are excluded.
